market: Houston metro / Greater Houston, Texas, USA
dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. For every included clinic, procedures[] contains every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed public price/treatment pages, not only the flagship Explore categories.
limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; booking-only, private-quote, login-only, unindexed or phone-only prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price were omitted rather than estimated.
Starting, range, package, per-unit, per-syringe, per-vial and per-graft semantics are preserved.
Public-directory, network-wide and crowdsourced pricing rows are explicitly marked with source_type and should rank below official clinic-site pricing.
Greater Houston includes nearby Bellaire, Sugar Land, Cypress and The Woodlands where relevant.
